a.xlink:title: Map 1 -- * FeatureA Feature has A Map. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one Map.A Map has some Features. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a Feature is created, its Map must be assigned. When a Feature is deleted, its Map is not deleted and its list of Features is decreased. When a Map is deleted, its Features are not deleted. They are assigned to another Map.
